notes:
v1.4.24 "Beacon"

• Your work now follows you across PCs — prescriptions ("My sheets") and admissions show the desk user who made them on whichever computer they sign in; older ones catch up automatically over the next hours
• The Patients page shows the whole hospital: "All dates" lists every patient, the day filter really filters (All patients + a date = every desk user's patients registered that day), and the stat cards count the real hospital
• Counter dashboards are read-only summaries — recent 10 sheets and admissions of the signed-in user, no New Patient button (registration lives on the Counter screen only)
• Prescriptions page: one clean toolbar — My/All sheets, day picker, live search; every card opens itself and the list refreshes itself
